build_sequentialflow_forward: build a python module to run SequentialFlow forward pass on input tensor x through chained flow layers
create_sequentialflow_with_layers: create a SequentialFlow container by passing multiple normalizing flow layer modules as arguments
run_sequentialflow_reverse: run the SequentialFlow forward method with reverse=True to invert the flow transformation through all layers
test_sequentialflow_logpx: test the SequentialFlow forward method with logpx argument to track log probability density changes
review_sequentialflow_inds: review the SequentialFlow forward method inds parameter to selectively apply a subset of chained layers
